headline: Micron Is Down 30% From Its High and Just Lost Its $1 Trillion Status
summary: Micron's revenue surged nearly 380% in a year, analysts expect even tighter memory supply through 2028, and more than 75% of next year's output is already committed. So why are investors selling as if the cycle has already peaked?
